items.q: Lan ______ the road when a motorbike suddenly pulled out in front of her.
items.vi: Lan đang băng qua đường thì một chiếc xe máy bất ngờ lao ra trước mặt cô.
items.explanation: Past continuous was crossing: a longer action in progress is interrupted by a short past-simple action after when (suddenly pulled out). ✗ crossed — past simple would make the crossing finish before the motorbike appeared, so nothing is interrupted; ✗ has crossed — present perfect cannot sit in a story told in the past (pulled out); ✗ had been crossing — past perfect continuous puts the crossing before an earlier past point, but the two events happen at the same moment.

items.q: The doctor said Nam should eat smaller ______ at dinner if he wants to lose weight.
items.vi: Bác sĩ nói Nam nên ăn những khẩu phần nhỏ hơn vào bữa tối nếu muốn giảm cân.
items.explanation: A portion is the amount of food served to one person, so eating smaller portions is how you lose weight. ✗ ingredients — the things a dish is made from; you don't eat 'smaller' ones; ✗ flavours — tastes, not amounts of food; ✗ recipes — sets of cooking instructions, which you follow, not eat.

items.q: You should ______ an appointment with the dentist before the holiday starts.
items.vi: Bạn nên đặt lịch hẹn với nha sĩ trước khi kỳ nghỉ bắt đầu.
items.explanation: Collocation: you make an appointment (arrange a fixed time to see someone). ✗ do — do goes with tasks (do homework), never with appointment; ✗ take — you take a test or a photo, not an appointment; ✗ put — needs a place or an object (put it down) and has no meaning with appointment.

items.q: The forum's rules are strict, so nobody can ______ posting rude comments for long.
items.vi: Quy định của diễn đàn rất nghiêm, nên không ai có thể đăng bình luận thô lỗ mà thoát được lâu.
items.explanation: Get away with = do something wrong without being punished; the clue is strict rules and rude comments. ✗ get on with — continue doing (or have a good relationship with); ✗ get round to — finally find time to do; ✗ get down to — start working seriously on. None of these involves escaping punishment.

items.q: The doctor ______ treated my brother has just moved to a hospital in Hue.
items.vi: Vị bác sĩ đã chữa cho anh tôi vừa chuyển đến một bệnh viện ở Huế.
items.explanation: The relative pronoun is the subject of treated (no other subject follows it) and refers to a person, the doctor, so it must be who. ✗ whom — object form only; here the pronoun does the treating; ✗ whose — shows possession and needs a noun after it (whose patient); ✗ which — for things, not people.

items.q: Since Grandma came home from hospital, everyone has been ______ around her so as not to upset her.
items.vi: Từ khi bà đi viện về, cả nhà ai cũng phải rón rén giữ ý quanh bà để không làm bà buồn.
items.explanation: Walk on eggshells = be very careful not to upset someone; the clue is so as not to upset her. ✗ walking on air — feeling extremely happy; ✗ walking on thin ice — being in a risky situation yourself; ✗ walking on water — doing the impossible. Only eggshells is about handling another person gently.

items.q: You ______ a taxi from the airport; the hotel bus was free for all guests.
items.vi: Bạn đã không cần phải đi taxi từ sân bay; xe buýt của khách sạn miễn phí cho mọi khách.
items.explanation: Needn't have + past participle = you did it, but it was not necessary; the clue is the hotel bus was free, so the taxi was a waste. ✗ must have taken — a confident guess that you did take one, not a comment on necessity; ✗ can't have taken — a guess that you did not take one, which contradicts the sentence; ✗ mustn't have taken — mustn't is not used for past deduction or past necessity.

items.q: The waiter brought us the ______ so that we could choose what to order.
items.vi: Người phục vụ mang thực đơn ra để chúng tôi chọn món.
items.explanation: The menu is the list you choose from before you order. ✗ dish — one prepared food item, something you order, not choose from; ✗ dessert — the sweet course at the end of a meal; ✗ snack — a small quick bite between meals. All three are food, not a list of food.

items.q: Nam looks tired because he ______ on the phone since eight o'clock this morning.
items.vi: Nam trông mệt mỏi vì cậu ấy nói chuyện điện thoại từ tám giờ sáng đến giờ.
items.explanation: Present perfect continuous has been talking: an action that began in the past (since eight o'clock) and continues to now, with a visible present result (looks tired). ✗ is talking — present continuous describes only now and cannot take since; ✗ was talking — past continuous means the call is over, but he is still tired from an ongoing one; ✗ talks — present simple is for habits, not an action lasting since a specific time.

items.q: There were very ______ tourists on the beach in the early morning, so it was wonderfully peaceful.
items.vi: Sáng sớm trên bãi biển có rất ít khách du lịch, nên nơi đó yên bình tuyệt vời.
items.explanation: Tourists is plural countable, and the meaning is 'almost none' (it was peaceful), so few; very also confirms it, since very goes only before few. ✗ a few — means 'some' and cannot follow very; ✗ little — for uncountable nouns (little time); ✗ a little — uncountable and positive ('some'), both wrong here.

items.q: Remember to ______ a photo of your passport before you travel abroad.
items.vi: Nhớ chụp một tấm ảnh hộ chiếu của bạn trước khi đi nước ngoài nhé.
items.explanation: Collocation: you take a photo. ✗ make — you make a copy or a film, but not a photo; ✗ do — goes with tasks (do the shopping), not with photo; ✗ catch — you catch a bus or a cold; with a photo it would mean nothing.

items.q: Bún bò Huế is a famous ______ of central Vietnam, which every visitor should try.
items.vi: Bún bò Huế là một đặc sản nổi tiếng của miền Trung Việt Nam mà du khách nào cũng nên thử.
items.explanation: A speciality is a food a place is famous for, which fits of central Vietnam and every visitor should try. ✗ ingredient — one component of a dish, but bún bò Huế is a whole dish; ✗ diet — what a person regularly eats, not a named dish; ✗ flavour — a taste, not something a region is famous for making.

items.q: If I ______ my phone charger at home, I could show you the holiday photos now.
items.vi: Nếu tôi không để quên sạc điện thoại ở nhà thì giờ tôi có thể cho bạn xem ảnh kỳ nghỉ rồi.
items.explanation: Mixed conditional: a past condition (leaving the charger at home) with a present result (could show you … now), so the if-clause takes the past perfect hadn't left. ✗ didn't leave — past simple would make a second conditional about a present or future situation, but the leaving already happened; ✗ haven't left — present perfect does not appear in unreal conditions; ✗ wouldn't leave — would belongs in the result clause, never after if.

items.q: Grandpa finds it hard to ______ all the new apps his grandchildren use.
items.vi: Ông thấy khó theo kịp tất cả những ứng dụng mới mà các cháu dùng.
items.explanation: Keep up with = stay at the same level as something changing fast, the clue being all the new apps. ✗ keep on with — continue doing something you have started; ✗ keep out of — stay away from trouble or a place; ✗ keep away from — avoid going near. Only keep up with is about following change.

items.q: While I ______ the hotel website, the internet connection suddenly dropped.
items.vi: Trong lúc tôi đang xem trang web của khách sạn thì kết nối mạng bỗng nhiên bị mất.
items.explanation: Past continuous was checking: while introduces a longer action in progress that is interrupted by a short past-simple event (suddenly dropped). ✗ checked — past simple makes two finished actions in sequence, not one interrupting the other; ✗ have checked — present perfect cannot combine with a past-simple main clause; ✗ am checking — present continuous clashes with the past time of dropped.

items.q: The hotel, the rooms ______ all face the sea, is fully booked until August.
items.vi: Khách sạn đó, với các phòng đều hướng ra biển, đã kín chỗ cho đến tận tháng Tám.
items.explanation: Possession placed after the noun for a thing takes of which: the rooms of which = whose rooms (the hotel's rooms). ✗ whose — must come before the noun (whose rooms all face), not after it; ✗ of whom — for people, but a hotel is a thing; ✗ in which — would mean the rooms are inside something, not that they belong to the hotel.

items.q: The receptionist reminded us ______ our room keys before we left the hotel.
items.vi: Lễ tân nhắc chúng tôi nộp lại chìa khóa phòng trước khi rời khách sạn.
items.explanation: Remind somebody to do something takes an object + to-infinitive: reminded us to hand in. ✗ handing in — the -ing form follows verbs like suggest or avoid, not remind + object; ✗ hand in — the bare infinitive follows make/let, not remind; ✗ to handing in — to + -ing only works when to is a preposition (look forward to), which it is not here.

items.q: My patience is beginning to ______ — the hostel Wi-Fi has stopped working for the third time today.
items.vi: Tôi bắt đầu hết kiên nhẫn rồi — Wi-Fi ở nhà nghỉ đã hỏng lần thứ ba trong ngày hôm nay.
items.explanation: When your patience wears thin, you gradually lose it; the clue is for the third time today. ✗ fall flat — a joke or plan fails to get the effect wanted; ✗ go blank — your mind suddenly remembers nothing; ✗ run wild — your imagination or children get out of control. None of these goes with patience.

items.q: The soup had a strong ______ of ginger, which really helped my sore throat.
items.vi: Món súp có vị gừng rất đậm, và điều đó thực sự giúp cổ họng đau của tôi dễ chịu hơn.
items.explanation: The flavour of a food is its particular taste, so a soup can have a strong flavour of ginger. ✗ texture — how food feels in the mouth (smooth, crunchy), not what it tastes of; ✗ appetite — a person's desire to eat, not a quality of soup; ✗ portion — the amount served, not the taste.

items.q: My sister loves crowded night markets, ______ I prefer quiet cafés by the river.
items.vi: Chị tôi thích những khu chợ đêm đông đúc, trong khi tôi lại thích những quán cà phê yên tĩnh bên sông.
items.explanation: Whereas links two full clauses that contrast two people: sister loves crowded markets vs. I prefer quiet cafés. ✗ despite — a preposition, so it cannot be followed by a clause with a subject and verb; ✗ so that — gives a purpose, but my preference is not the purpose of hers; ✗ otherwise — means 'if not', which makes no sense between two likes.

items.q: Passengers ______ switch their phones to flight mode before the plane takes off; it is an airline rule.
items.vi: Hành khách phải chuyển điện thoại sang chế độ máy bay trước khi máy bay cất cánh; đó là quy định của hãng.
items.explanation: A rule or strong obligation takes must; the clue is it is an airline rule. ✗ might — only a possibility, not an obligation; ✗ could — ability or possibility, not something required; ✗ would — hypothetical or past habit, not a present rule.

items.q: Lan ______ a bad cold on the plane and spent the first two days of the holiday in bed.
items.vi: Lan bị cảm nặng trên máy bay và nằm giường suốt hai ngày đầu của kỳ nghỉ.
items.explanation: Collocation: you catch a cold (become ill with one). ✗ took — you take medicine or a break, not an illness; ✗ made — you make things, and a cold is not something you create; ✗ held — you hold objects or meetings, not illnesses.

items.q: ______ had we boarded the plane when the baby behind us started crying.
items.vi: Chúng tôi vừa mới lên máy bay thì em bé ngồi sau bắt đầu khóc.
items.explanation: Inversion Hardly had we boarded … when …: Hardly + past perfect pairs with when for an event that happened almost immediately. ✗ No sooner — must pair with than, not when; ✗ Not until — needs a time clause first (Not until we boarded did …), and the inversion comes in the main clause; ✗ Only when — likewise needs a clause before the inversion, not had we directly.

items.q: The doctor put Grandpa on a low-salt ______ after his blood pressure test.
items.vi: Sau khi đo huyết áp, bác sĩ cho ông theo chế độ ăn ít muối.
items.explanation: A diet is the food a person regularly eats, often for health, so a doctor puts a patient on a low-salt diet after a blood pressure test. ✗ meal — one occasion of eating, not a long-term plan; ✗ dish — one prepared food item; ✗ menu — a restaurant's list of food, not a health plan.

items.q: When we finally reached the gate, the plane ______ already.
items.vi: Khi cuối cùng chúng tôi tới được cửa ra máy bay thì máy bay đã cất cánh rồi.
items.explanation: Past perfect had left: the plane's departure happened before the past moment of reached the gate, and already confirms the earlier action. ✗ left — past simple would make the two events happen at the same time or in order, but the plane was gone first; ✗ has left — present perfect clashes with the past-simple reached; ✗ was leaving — past continuous means it was still leaving as we arrived, but already says it was gone.
